tests: The common SMB-support case: modest Sonnet token load with a healthy cache rate, where cheap sendgrid emails plus a zero-marginal-cost stripe refund make LLM tokens the dominant cost driver.

expected_truth.how_computed: Model claude-sonnet-4-6: input $3.00/MTok = 3e-6/tok, output $15.00/MTok = 15e-6/tok, cache_discount 0.90, tokenizer_inflation 1.0. raw_per_call = 1400*3e-6 + 300*15e-6 = 0.0042 + 0.0045 = 0.0087. cache multiplier = 1 - cache_frac*cache_discount = 1 - 0.60*0.90 = 0.46. retry multiplier = 1 + 0.03 = 1.03. llm_per_call = 0.0087 * 0.46 * 1.03 = 0.00412206. tool_per_call = 0.35*0 (zendesk.get_ticket) + 0.25*0 (zendesk.list_tickets) + 0.30*0.0004 (email.send_email -> sendgrid send_email price) + 0.10*0 (stripe.create_refund) = 0.00012. infra = 0.001. monthly = 100 calls/day * 30 days * (0.00412206 + 0.00012 + 0.001) = 3000 * 0.00524206 = 15.72618 ~= $15.73. monthly_range = 15.7262 * [0.85, 1.15] = [13.3673, 18.0851].

why_low_tier_will_miss: The LOW tier's static token estimate (turnDefaults ~ 800 system + 400/tool + 120 user + 500 tool_result + 300 completion across 4 turns) and uniform tool distribution won't match this agent's actual 1400-in/300-out per call at 60% cache, so its per-call LLM figure drifts from the $0.00412 truth; convergence to watch is the LOW forecast landing somewhere in the ~$10-25/month band as the calls/day=100 default happens to coincide here while the token mix does not.
